authorization: Explicit user-approved local CPU fallback; not dispatched by MCP. No physical simulation, models or services installed. Existing numpy/sklearn available.
diagnostics: Full and all 5 deletion predictions, coefficients, selections, timings, design rank and singular values
Analytic certificate and an explicitly constructed boundary perturbation that ties a rival, with below-bound and above-bound checks
Heldout observed best, selected regret log10(best_sigma/selected_sigma), coverage and conditional mean regret; abstention regret UNKNOWN, never zero
failure_conditions: Wrong temperature/observable/units or missing route mapping
Numerical certificate inconsistent with explicit perturbation
No original specimen or measurement-error definition inferred
fairness: One fixed 6-fit menu per train DOI shared across policies, 12 unique fits total. Count observed shared computation once; policies have equal maximum permitted budget, not equal measured standalone cost. Cheap baselines need no fitted model; no invented runtime savings.
heldout_design: Train entire one DOI, evaluate other DOI. Delete each of five training conditions independently; never delete or fit on heldout outcomes. Only two papers, all outcomes exposed before this protocol.
leakage: No OBELiX TRAIN/TEST opened, retrained or tuned. Original TEST121 untouched. Source labels previously public; study-out sensitivity, not independent confirmation.

model.absolute_RF_offset: Not rerun. Offset is constant within each same-formula paper and cancels all within-paper ranks/margins. Do not report absolute prediction MAE.

next_action_rule: If instability or stable wrong selection occurs, request an independently source-qualified study with non-confounded temperature/dwell design and defined EIS uncertainty. Otherwise obtain such a study before claiming generalization. Publisher TableS1 geometry remains a separate unresolved action.

questions.H1: Are both full-data 0191 directional process top-one recommendations invariant to every single training-condition deletion?
questions.H1_falsification: Any deletion changes the unique selected condition or produces a tie.
questions.H2: Does a fixed deletion-and-label-stress stability filter retain at least one recommendation with zero observed top-one regret across these two exposed heldout studies?
questions.H2_falsification: Any retained recommendation has strictly positive observed regret; no retained recommendation makes H2 INCONCLUSIVE rather than PASS.

radius: For full winner w and rival j, H maps training log labels to heldout predictions; epsilon_j=(prediction_w-prediction_j)/L1(H_w-H_j). Minimum over rivals is exact least bounded training-label change to create a tie. Zero-distance rivals imply tie/abstention, not infinite confidence.
scope: Separate fallback experiment; original #367 publisher protocols unchanged. Authenticated historical public labels, not independent or blind validation.

selection.composition_only: O_ONLY/pooled composition-only comparators necessarily tie within each same-nominal-formula paper; ABSTAIN, no model rerun/accuracy claims.
selection.full_Ridge: Unique maximum on heldout pre-EIS features, using training labels only.
selection.hotter_shorter: Lexicographic max temperature, then minimum holding time; unresolved ties ABSTAIN.
selection.robust_filter: Keep full Ridge recommendation only if unchanged under all 5 single-training-condition deletions and its exact L_infinity training-label perturbation radius exceeds 0.1 log10 units.
selection.shorter_cooler: Lexicographic min holding time, then minimum temperature; unresolved ties ABSTAIN.
selection.stress_delta_meaning: PROVISIONAL deterministic adversarial sensitivity test, NOT source measurement uncertainty or calibrated confidence.
selection.tie: ABSTAIN; no truth-selected or filename tie-break
